verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents issuing dedicated virtual cards with their own limits. The API issues, tops up, reveals and cancels VCNs for "uses you define", and CUSTOM VCNs carry their own ceiling, time window and adjustable controls. Marketing pages also promote one-click virtual cards per purpose, explicitly including software, each with its own limit and assigned owner. So a finance lead can isolate spend per card, but nothing shows a card can be locked to a single merchant or vendor: the evidence describes cards per category or purpose, not per vendor. Missing for 10: explicit merchant/vendor-lock controls on virtual cards, documentation of what the CUSTOM VCN "controls" restrict, and independent or hands-on corroboration of per-vendor subscription cards.
